management_steps.details: Absolute indications: GCS <13 initially or <15 at 2 hours, open/depressed/base-of-skull fracture, post-traumatic seizure, focal neuro deficit, anticoagulants
Head up 30-45°, MAP >90 (unless ICH then >75-80), PCO2 34-40 (normocarbia), O2 sats >95% (normoxia), glucose 5-10 mmol/L, avoid neck pressure (C-spine collars)

warnings: Avoid steroids in traumatic intracranial hemorrhage — no therapeutic role
